in_hebrew.name: Wally
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Wally הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English name Walh, meaning 'ruler, valiant, stranger'. The name is derived from the Old High German name Walah, which meant 'foreigner, stranger'. In Germanic mythology, Walhaz was the name of the god of the dead, and the land of the dead was called Walhalla. In Christian tradition, the name Wally has been used as a diminutive of Walter, which means 'ruler, warrior'.
